title: Malik Willis on celebrating Dolphins' win: We're 1-5, it's not like we won the Super Bowl

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Malik Willis on celebrating Dolphins' win: We're 1-5, it's not like we won the Super Bowl
sources.description: The Dolphins won their first game of the season on Sunday, but quarterback Malik Willis said it's important to put that win in perspective.
